items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Pickett, did you find on Dixieland?

ctx.x: That's who Bob really wants, you see. But I don't think he'll do it. That's who Bob really wants, Pickett, you see. Who? With a man like Howard, I heard. Oh, yeah. Yeah. See, that's what Bob won.
Pickett, did you find on Dixieland?
Actually, yeah, Bob musician. Oh, yeah? Uh-huh. He went away with Bob, nice musician.
